description: Ask Claude Code's /skill-doctor, headlessly, what PAN's installed skills cost in context; the report is the static half of the body-budget measurement.
why: Reality check R21 step 1: /skill-doctor (Claude Code >= 2.1.261) reports loaded skills and their context cost. On the shipped install it shows what every session pays to have focus-design and its siblings loaded; the A/B arms show whether the split changes outcomes. Recorded, not asserted beyond the command running and naming the command under test.

steps.why: The report must mention the command under test; its numbers are the measurement and are read from the run's report, not asserted.
